create_Owlv2Processor: create an Owlv2Processor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal object detection
call_Owlv2Processor: call Owlv2Processor with images and text to produce input_ids, attention_mask, and pixel_values tensors
post_process_grounded_object_detection: post process Owlv2Processor output with post_process_grounded_object_detection to get bounding boxes and text labels
post_process_image_guided_detection: post process Owlv2Processor image-guided detection output with post_process_image_guided_detection applying nms and threshold filtering
configure_Owlv2ProcessorKwargs: configure Owlv2ProcessorKwargs with query_images for image-to-image object detection instead of text prompts
